nodes.label: Admin Dashboard Performance Requirements
nodes.rationale: FCP < 1.8s, LCP < 2.5s, FID < 100ms, TTI < 5s, TBT < 300ms, CLS < 0.1, SI < 4.3s, TTFB < 600ms, FMP < 2.5s. Page size must be between 150KB, critical JS/CSS below 100KB. Enforced via Lighthouse.

nodes.label: Admin Dashboard Folder Structure Convention
nodes.rationale: app/ (routes & layouts), lib/hooks, lib/hoc, lib/services, lib/ui, lib/utils (methods, interfaces, constants, types). cypress/ for tests. Enforces separation of concerns and 100-200 lines per component guideline.

nodes.label: RTL/LTR Language Direction Support (i18n.dir())
nodes.rationale: Removed i18next.on('languageChanged') listener and replaced with i18n.dir() for automatic RTL/LTR determination. app.json supportsRTL and forcesRTL flags set to false to let the library handle direction.
